name: 29771-longprompt-step35flashfp8-tp8
model: stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash-FP8 -- ungated, 208.6 GB. The bf16 twin stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash (398.8 GB) is the same architecture and does not fit at tp8 with room for KV.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=8, PP=1, DP=1 on one node, no router and no external cache tier. EP=8 is required rather than chosen: block-quantized fp8 needs each rank's expert intermediate width to be a multiple of 128, and 1280 split eight ways is 160.
architecture: Step3p5ForCausalLM, 45 layers, hybrid attention (one full-attention layer in four, the rest windowed at 512 tokens), fp8 e4m3 block-wise expert weights with the rest of the model in bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 32 streams, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix: prompts centred on 8000 tokens (stdev 500, clamped 6000-10000) and generations centred on 200 tokens (stdev 25, clamped 128-300), at temperature 0.0 with ignore_eos true. Long in, short out.
purpose: A document analysis assistant giving short answers over long single-turn reports, 32 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# The launch keys. Anything absent here is a stock default of the pinned commit.
model-path: stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash-FP8
tp-size: 8

# NOT optional: block-quantized fp8 requires each rank's expert intermediate width to be a
# multiple of block_n = 128, and splitting moe_intermediate_size 1280 eight ways gives 160, which
# `fp8.py` rejects at weight creation. Whole experts per rank keeps the width at 1280.
ep-size: 8
